# Parent Coach Desk

> Parent Coach Desk offers structured, evergreen guidance for parents coaching or supporting children in sports and activities. It focuses on useful conversations, sound decisions, healthy relationships, and safer youth sports experiences.

## Core content

### Coaching and parenting strategies

- [Coaching your own kid in front of the team](https://parentcoachdesk.com/game/coaching-your-own-kid-in-front-of-the-team/)
- [Three drives, one relationship](https://parentcoachdesk.com/drive-home/three-drives-one-relationship/)
- [The assistant-coaching pressure](https://parentcoachdesk.com/drive-home/the-you-should-be-assistant-coaching-pressure/)
- [In-the-moment coaching decisions](https://parentcoachdesk.com/game/)
- [Post-game relationship management](https://parentcoachdesk.com/drive-home/)

### Decisions and communication

- [What to say in youth sports moments](https://parentcoachdesk.com/scripts/)
- [Youth sports pendulum](https://parentcoachdesk.com/youth-sports-pendulum/)
- [Travel, specialization, quitting, and other decisions](https://parentcoachdesk.com/decisions/)
- [Youth sports cost calculator](https://parentcoachdesk.com/cost-calculator/)

### Before, during, and after the game

- [Before the game](https://parentcoachdesk.com/drive-there/)
